claim: The sample demo opens in one click and stays separate from real captions and settings.
where: landing action, demo banner, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; seed real IndexedDB data; exercise, reset, and leave /demo; compare both storage namespaces

claim: Caption Lanes separates captions into left, centre, and right lanes with manual keyboard placement.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; assert all three lanes and place a typed caption with the number-key control

claim: A stereo microphone can provide a coarse left, centre, or right hint, and its audio track stops when captions pause.
sandbox: enter the real flow from /demo with recorded stereo analyser samples; assert the left hint, strong label, and stopped track

claim: The caption demo sends no data to another origin and never requests microphone access.
sandbox: fresh /demo; record every request; add and export a caption; inspect the request origins and microphone call count

claim: Caption Lanes never retains raw microphone audio; only caption fields are stored and exported.
where: landing facts, consent, privacy page, README
sandbox: enter the real flow from /demo with recorded speech and mono-stream fixtures; assert no MediaRecorder use, stopped track, IndexedDB fields, and export flag

claim: The installed app opens offline after one online visit.
sandbox: new browser context at /demo; install and control the service worker; set context offline; reload the exact demo URL

claim: Real caption text and display settings stay in the browser across reloads until cleared.
sandbox: fresh /demo; choose Start for real; add a caption; reload; reopen typed captions

claim: Users can export and import caption text as JSON.
where: How it works, Settings, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; parse the downloaded JSON; import a replacement fixture and assert visible rows

claim: Typed captions ignore blank input and stop at 240 characters.
sandbox: fresh /demo; submit spaces; enter 241 characters; assert zero blank rows and an exact 240-character value

claim: Hide uncertain captions removes results below 60 percent confidence and keeps the 60 percent boundary.
sandbox: fresh /demo; import recorded 0.59 and 0.60 fixtures; enable the filter and compare visible captions

claim: Live speech requires browser-confirmed on-device processing and remains optional because typed captions work without it.
sandbox: enter the real flow from /demo with recorded browser speech fixtures; reject missing processLocally support and assert true when supported

claim: Caption Lanes Plus costs $24 once, adds a fourth lane, and reuses a valid verification for one day.
where: landing facts, paid section, terms, README
sandbox: fresh /demo; enter real mode with a recorded valid verification; assert price, checkout URL, four lanes, and one request across reload
